text: The two RWB-AD-013 slices of rwb-access are delivered once, by the parallel Work Package B-P4-04, and the two story files and two fragments it wrote are kept unchanged; Work Package B2-P4-007 registers only the duplicate-Work-Package finding and writes no second version of the story files, no second fragment and no second gap or assumption set for this legacy key.
why: Root AGENTS.md rule 1 forbids editing a file that already exists and forbids writing a path outside the 'Write only' block, so the v2 copy that rule 1 would otherwise ask for cannot be created inside this Work Package, and rule 13 forbids stopping the run. The precedent of section B2-P4-002 for RWB-AD-003 (CG-B2-P4-002-1; ASM-B2-P4-002-1) settles the same collision the same way, so the folder family keeps one citation set per legacy key.
